findings.detail: two powers here are called "crown"; the short form says neither
took the seat. Beald Feald Feithsith was cast out,
“The conflict with the Peirnhewick Crown was the central feature, resulting in two wars and the loss of two pl…” — says 2 wars, but 4 named
“Thethden Steith was cast out in 35 for attempted murder” — says steith was cast out in 27, but and in 35
the killing of Kaell Rillwem in 30 is what opened the seat, and is told after Duth Traellkeild takes it
“The period saw seven people hold the seat, with five killed, one cast out, and Veall Lea still holding it at …” — says 7 in total, but the parts add to 6
“Four people held the seat in total: two were cast out, one died, and one remained holding it at the end of th…” — says 4 in total, but the parts add to 3
prose says 'seized', which would need a record of 'coup'; there is none
two powers here are called "crown"; the short form says neither
…Tharnpeil Waeld then took the seat, only to be killed in 48 by Vold Freideth… — waeld did not kill freideth; grorn did
“Externally, the Crown fought two wars” — says 2 wars, but 3 named
Sa Cut was lost in 48 and is never named
Fum Seas held the seat from 48 to 51, and no sentence here says so
